Visual Thinking

This module provides a practical introduction to graphic design that outlines the fundamental concepts, methods and tools that underpin the culture of the programme in order todevelop Graphic Design students’ conceptual and lateral thinking to solve design problems.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Analyse visual source material to identify influences, themes, and strategies relevant to the development of creative wor

+  Develop creative visual ideas in response to a design brief, demonstrating experimentation and iterative thinking

+  Produce a resolved design solution that effectively communicates the intended message

+  Evaluate design work, to assess the effectiveness of visual elements.
